newsitem.title: UK: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil softer.
newsitem.headline: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil softer.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil was notionally softer with crude but prices remained at a stand-off on Tuesday, traders said.
U.S. buying interest was thought to be pegged at around $124 fob NWE, well below levels considered by most sellers.

High sulphur cargoes were little changed although soaring high sulphur cracked fuel barge prices, on the back of an unspecified temporary problem at Shell's refinery in Rotterdam, are likely to impact cargo pricing.
